profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems Inc. describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider delivering hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. Its website uses the tagline "Computational Software for Intelligent System Design" and states that the company is about being a great company, citing its culture, inclusion on Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work, and investment in sustainability.

The company is a public, for-profit organization headquartered in San Jose, California, trading under the ticker CDNS. Its SEC CIK number is 0000813672. Public records show 281 legal exposure entries in California. The site text does not name individual AI products.
